scripts.dev: npm run assets:build && concurrently -k -n world-host,world,client,assets -c magenta,blue,green,yellow "npm run world:host" "npm run world:dev" "npm run dev -w @orchard/client" "npm run watch -w @orchard/tools"
scripts.build: npm run assets:build && npm run build -w @orchard/sim && npm run build -w @orchard/tools && npm run build -w @orchard/world && npm run build -w @orchard/client
scripts.check: npm run build -w @orchard/world && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run assets:validate
scripts.world:dev: sh -c 'until curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/v1/ping >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 0.2; done; exec spacetime dev orchard-cellar-world --no-config --server local --project-path . --module-path packages/world --module-bindings-path packages/client/src/net/generated --client-lang typescript --yes --server-only'
scripts.world:load: spacetime publish orchard-cellar-netcode-load --server local --module-path packages/world --yes --delete-data && tsx scripts/netcode-load.ts
scripts.world:crash-ghost: spacetime publish orchard-cellar-netcode-crash --server local --module-path packages/world --yes --delete-data && SPACETIMEDB_DATABASE=orchard-cellar-netcode-crash tsx scripts/netcode-crash-ghost.ts
scripts.world:action-check: spacetime publish orchard-cellar-netcode-action --server local --module-path packages/world --yes --delete-data && SPACETIMEDB_DATABASE=orchard-cellar-netcode-action tsx scripts/netcode-action.ts
scripts.world:tap-check: spacetime publish orchard-cellar-netcode-tap --server local --module-path packages/world --yes --delete-data && SPACETIMEDB_DATABASE=orchard-cellar-netcode-tap tsx scripts/netcode-tap.ts
